description:
Create a Porter's Value Chain Analysis diagram for a company named 'EcoTech Electronics'. 

1. Open Wondershare EdrawMax and create a new 'Value Chain' diagram (found under Business > Strategy and Planning, or by searching 'Value Chain').
2. Set the diagram title to: 'EcoTech Electronics Value Chain Analysis'.
3. Populate the 'Support Activities' (the upper horizontal rows) with the following specific text:
   - Firm Infrastructure: 'Cloud-based ERP, Leed Certified HQ'
   - Human Resource Management: 'Remote-first policy, STEM recruiting'
   - Technology Development: 'AI R&D Lab, IoT Patent Portfolio'
   - Procurement: 'Sustainable silicon sourcing, Global vendor portal'
4. Populate the 'Primary Activities' (the lower vertical columns/chevrons) with the following text:
   - Inbound Logistics: 'JIT Component Delivery'
   - Operations: 'Robotic Assembly, Quality Control'
   - Outbound Logistics: 'Global Distribution Centers'
   - Marketing & Sales: 'Direct-to-Consumer Website'
   - Service: '24/7 Chatbot Support'
5. Save the project file to '/home/ga/Documents/ecotech_value_chain.eddx'.
6. Export the diagram as an image to '/home/ga/Documents/ecotech_value_chain.png'.
